title: Quiet Lake Website Loop
tests: Tests whether the delivered website background has subtle real motion and a visually seamless repeat rather than merely being a short scenic video.

faults.what: The supplied clip duration is 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: A calm, fixed-view mountain lake at dusk with subtle water movement suits the background brief, but the clip runs 6.6 seconds and its loop boundary and silence cannot be verified from still frames.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is a 6-second landscape 16:9 video showing a mountain lake at dusk.
must_haves.why: The landscape framing and mountain lake at dusk match, but the supplied duration is 6.6 seconds.

must_haves.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water; the output is not a static image held for six seconds.
must_haves.why: Water ripple patterns and reflections subtly change across the sampled frames while the landscape stays consistent.

must_haves.item: The camera remains fixed, with no pans, zooms or scene cuts.
must_haves.why: Mountain peaks, shoreline and framing remain aligned throughout the supplied frames, with no visible camera movement or cuts.

must_haves.item: Repeated playback has no perceptible jump, flash or abrupt motion reset at the boundary.
must_haves.why: The samples do not show the actual end-to-start transition, so seamless looping cannot be established.

must_haves.item: The centre remains visually calm, without prominent moving foreground objects competing with a website heading.
must_haves.why: The centre contains only distant mountains and softly rippling water, with no prominent foreground distractions.

must_haves.item: There is no visible text and no audible sound.
must_haves.why: No text is visible, but audio presence or absence cannot be assessed from the provided still frames.
